Materials

Gold vermeil over sterling silver [PLACEHOLDER: confirm metal, gold karat and thickness in microns]

Vermeil is a thick layer of gold over a sterling silver base. It keeps its colour well with everyday wear but, like all gold over silver, it can soften over time with friction, perfume and water. If the silver beneath ever darkens, a soft dry cloth brings it back.
